docs.text: Google review of CVS (1 out of 5, by Annie Wu, 6 months ago): Be aware! This is the worst pharmacy and stay away! Our patient went yesterday to get her prescription but was told no medication for her and she needed to call the doctor for new prescription.  However, her prescription was just sent on 3/11/26, and it doesn’t make sense, so we called this CVS.  We were told the medication was cancelled by a pharmacist on 3/11 due to confusion but never confirmed with our office.  I, as a prescriber, wanted to find out what happened. After waiting on the phone for 15 minutes, came the manager who’s very arrogant claimed the medication was cancelled due to “another medication also prescribed on the same day, they were considered as the same medications”.  Obviously she’s not a medical professional and I tried to correct what she said was not true. Then she said “you don’t listen to me then we won’t fill the medication for the patient.” And I heard someone next to her laughed out very loud as if they nailed the situation.  How low was that! Use a patient’s wellbeing to threaten! How could a person like this works as a manger at CVS pharmacy!  No sense of caring, compassion or sympathy at all!  Fortunately there are many other pharmacies that doctors and patients can choose, we definitely won’t send our patients to pharmacy like this anymore!

Google review of CVS Pharmacy (5 out of 5, by Rick Yalie, 4 months ago): As always my Rx were filled and ready at the designated time. In addition, the self scanning monitors are more efficient and easier to use than when they first introduced.

However one major issue has been overlooked, and rather unexpected from a pharmacy by the use of the self help.

Health experts estimate that approximately 80% of common infectious diseases are spread through direct or indirect hand contact. Touching contaminated surfaces and then touching your eyes, nose, or mouth is the primary way these germs enter your body.

Given that everyone is directed to the self help scanner for check in, and the likelihood that the majority of Rx for pickup are from clients that maybe carriers of contagious illnesses, their should be alcohol pads available for quick cleaning, especially for seniors who are more vulnerable.

I was surprised that almost every time at check in,  I have seen the finger prints from prior users. While my experiences at CVS are always a 10+, I thought highlighting this issue merited sharing.

Google review of Tribeca Apothecary (1 out of 5, by Trevor Heath, 4 months ago): Terrible communication practices and lack of transparency. I was told by my dermatologist that Tribeca Apothecary would submit an authorization to my insurance company to determine coverage of a $2,000+ prescription. I was texted that they had submitted the prior authorization and would inform me once a determination was made from my insurance. The next day, I was texted that the cost was $0 and to confirm my address in their system was correct. No explanation of coverage or details about the prescription were provided and they did not request my approval to fulfill the prescription. I told them my address, as they had listed the incorrect address, and was texted that my prescription would be delivered. Two days later, I receive a bill from my insurance for over $1,000 (50% of the prescription) stating it was authorized. When I spoke to Tribeca's staff today, they said me correcting them with my address was confirming to fulfill the order.

For better business practices, work on your communication and request exact confirmation from your clients rather than basing confirmation on a client correcting you on address details. Nowhere in your communication practices do you explicitly request authorization from the client. Absolutely absurd business practices.

docs.text: Google review of Sky Dental (5 out of 5, by Rebecca Scheckman, 5 months ago): Great experience with my now 2 year old. docs.title: Review of Sky Dental

Google review of Sky Dental (5 out of 5, by KeShauna Sanders, 3 months ago): I cannot say enough great things about this dental office. After several terrible experiences with dentists in the past, I was understandably nervous about finding a new provider. From the moment I walked through the door, I was treated with kindness, professionalism, and genuine respect.

Dr. Puzio and the entire team go above and beyond to make patients feel comfortable, valued, and cared for. A special thank you to my hygienist, Tiffany, who took the time to listen to my concerns, thoroughly explain every procedure, and make sure I felt at ease throughout my visit. Her patience and compassion made all the difference.

The professionalism throughout the office is outstanding, from Dr. Puzio and Dental Assistants to the exceptional front desk team. Everyone works together to create a welcoming and positive experience. The quality of care I have received has completely restored my confidence in going to the dentist, and I am truly grateful to have found such a wonderful practice.

docs.title: Review of Sky Dental
docs.text:
Google review of Sky Dental (5 out of 5, by Seena Alamarie, 3 months ago): Sky Dental has honestly been one of the best dental offices I’ve been to. Everyone is welcoming, and the entire office makes you feel comfortable from the moment you walk in.

Dr. Tonkian is incredibly thorough and attentive. She took her time during my initial exam and X-rays, explained everything clearly, and never made me feel rushed. She actually listens when you tell her something hurts, and you can tell she has the experience to know when something with your teeth or bite isn’t quite right. One thing I really LOVED was that she gave me breaks throughout the appointment to let me relax my jaw. I’ve never had another dentist do that before, and it made the entire experience so much easier and more comfortable.

Jessie at the front desk is also amazing. He’s always so kind, organized, and on top of everything. Whether I have questions or need help scheduling an appointment, he’s always happy to help.

It’s hard to find a dental office where you feel like people genuinely care, but that’s exactly how I felt at Sky Dental. If you’ve been putting off going to the dentist or have dental anxiety, I definitely recommend coming here.

docs.title: Review of Sky Dental

Jessie at the front desk was also very helpful and made everything easy. Great experience overall, 100% will recommend!!

docs.title: Review of Tribeca Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, PLLC
docs.text:
Google review of Tribeca Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, PLLC (5 out of 5, by Holly McDowell, 2 months ago): I couldn’t recommend Dr. Fay and her office more for wisdom tooth removal. I had all four of my wisdom teeth removed, and I was extremely nervous about the procedure. From the moment I arrived, the front desk staff were so kind, welcoming, and helpful.

Before the surgery, Dr. Fay took the time to thoroughly explain the procedure and what I could expect, which really helped put my mind at ease. On the day of the surgery, she was incredibly reassuring and did a great job calming my nerves.

The entire process was seamless, and my recovery was far better than I expected. I experienced little to no pain, and everything healed exactly as Dr. Fay said it would. The office also called to check in on my recovery, which I really appreciated, and Dr. Fay saw me one week later for a follow-up appointment to make sure everything was healing properly.

I truly couldn’t recommend Dr. Fay and her team more. Their professionalism, compassion, and excellent care made what I expected to be a stressful experience an incredibly positive one.

docs.title: Review of Tribeca Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, PLLC
docs.text:
Google review of Tribeca Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, PLLC (2 out of 5, by David Bazargan, 4 months ago): Dr. Fay is very caring, knowledgeable, and takes the time to listen to her patients. However, the office appears to be short-staffed and disorganized.

I booked my appointment a week in advance, but only 30 minutes before my scheduled visit did the staff realize they did not have my insurance information on file. As a result, I had to take an Uber home to retrieve my insurance card.

In addition, my appointment was scheduled for 10:00 a.m., but I was not seen by the doctor until approximately 12:30 p.m.

Finally, although Dr. Fay indicated that my prescription had been sent to the pharmacy, it had not been ordered. I only discovered this after waiting in line at the pharmacy for about 30 minutes.

While I appreciate Dr. Fay's professionalism and medical expertise, the office administration and scheduling process need significant improvement.

docs.title: Review of Tribeca Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, PLLC
docs.text: Google review of Tribeca Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, PLLC (5 out of 5, by Katrina Leung, 9 months ago): Everyone is so nice here! Super accommodating in terms of scheduling. I had my wisdom teeth taken out, it was my first time going under and felt like my hand was held the whole time. Recovery was super smooth and quick which speaks to Dr. Fays skill.

docs.title: Review of Tribeca Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, PLLC
docs.text:
Google review of Tribeca Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, PLLC (5 out of 5, by Ja'shon Bass, 7 months ago): I had all four of my wisdom teeth removed by Dr.Fay, and I have no regrets.

I was fully sedated during my procedure and felt no pain at all. The entire team had a very calm, friendly bedside manner—they even put a warm blanket on me before anesthesia, which really helped me relax. I went to sleep feeling completely comfortable.

Before the surgery, Dr.Fay took the time to clearly explain my situation and what the procedure would involve, which gave me a lot of confidence going in. Recovery overall was smooth. Because my lower wisdom teeth were positioned sideways, I did experience some temporary numbness in my right lip and chin area (which is normal for cases like mine). What really stood out was how attentive and reassuring Dr.Fay was. She scheduled follow-up appointments, monitored the healing closely, and everything resolved exactly as she said it would. At this point in time, I’m fully back to normal.

The front desk staff were also friendly and helpful, and I appreciated the post-procedure check-in call.

If you’re getting your wisdom teeth extracted here, you’re absolutely in good hands. Thanks Dr.Fay!

docs.title: Review of Tribeca Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, PLLC
docs.text:
Google review of Tribeca Oral and Maxillofacial Surgery, PLLC (5 out of 5, by corrine cocco, 10 months ago): I cannot say enough amazing things about Dr. Fay and her team. After years of dental anxiety stemming from a childhood experience, and after three separate consults with other oral surgeons, I kept putting off getting my dental implant. The fear always won—until I met Dr. Fay.

From my very first consult two months ago, I immediately felt comfortable with her. Beyond her years of experience and expertise, she has a calm, reassuring presence that made me feel understood. She spent so much time with me, answered every question, and never once made me feel pressured to schedule anything. It truly was a consult, not a sales pitch, and that alone earned my trust.

Today I finally had my implant placed, and I went in terrified—even though I trusted her completely. I can honestly say the entire experience was nothing like I feared. In fact, getting a tooth extracted in the past was far worse than the first stage of this implant. I didn’t use sedation or laughing gas; once she numbed me, I was perfectly fine. The whole thing took about 45 minutes, and Dr. Fay talked me through every step, keeping me calm and comfortable.

I also want to mention Kayla at the front desk. When I walked in, it was obvious how anxious I was. She took one look at me, grabbed my hand, and said, “You’ve got this.” It set the tone for the entire visit and truly meant more than she knows.

As someone who works in the medical field, I was especially impressed by the professionalism, warmth, and compassion shown by Dr. Fay and her entire staff. I genuinely appreciated the level of care I received.

Dr. Fay and her team are exceptional. I would recommend her to absolutely anyone—but especially to those with dental anxiety. My only regret is not doing this sooner.

Thank you, Dr. Fay, for giving me the confidence and care I’ve been searching for all these years.

JESSICA did my intake. She was professional, efficient and very welcoming. Next, I was greeted by AZIZ, the dental assistant, who OFFERED to carry my heavy bag into the exam room! He asked what brought me into the office, efficiently took x-rays and pleasantly chatted.

There was NO WAIT TIME for Dr. KHERZI! Her bedside manner is personable and not rushed; she is very knowledgeable and patiently explained the diagnosis, treatment plan and next steps.

The doctor recommended that I buy a specific electric toothbrush and AZIZ, without me knowing, immediately googled it so I knew where to buy.

At checkout, ALEKSANDRA accommodated my request for an appointment that was a consultation and treatment on the same day; Now I don’t have to make two trips back to the office from Jersey.

At this practice, the patient care and consideration is above and beyond my expectations and I highly recommend it!

docs.title: Review of Expert Dental - Tribeca
docs.text:
Google review of Expert Dental - Tribeca (5 out of 5, by Calli Greenwald, 2 months ago): I’ve had such a great experience with Expert Dental and would highly recommend them! I originally went to them for Invisalign, and I’m so happy with my results. Once my Invisalign was off, I wanted to make sure my teeth looked as even and symmetrical as possible. The doctors were incredibly patient with me and really listened to how important this was to me. We talked through the options of reshaping my teeth versus bonding, and they took the time to carefully make small adjustments so that my teeth looked more symmetrical and natural. I really appreciated how much attention they gave to something that was important to me.

I’ve since continued seeing them for my general dentistry needs as well, including having a crown done. They offer same-day crowns, which made the process so much more convenient.

The offices are incredibly clean and modern, with state-of-the-art technology, and the doctors are always patient, thorough, and willing to take the time to explain everything. I’ve also referred friends to Expert Dental for veneers, and they’ve had great experiences as well.

What I really appreciate is that they’re truly a full-service dental practice, so you can go to one place for everything from orthodontics and routine dentistry to cosmetic work. I also love that they have multiple locations throughout the city, which makes it easy to visit whichever office is most convenient. They’re open on weekends as well, which is such a huge plus for anyone with a busy work schedule.

I’ll definitely continue recommending Expert Dental — especially to anyone considering Invisalign or looking for a dental practice where you can have all of your dental needs taken care of in one place!

docs.title: Review of Liberty Endoscopy Center
docs.text:
Google review of Liberty Endoscopy Center (5 out of 5, by Kimberly J, a month ago): This was truly the best experience I have ever had in a medical situation, especially as a WOC. As someone who has never had surgery before, I was an absolute nervous wreck coming in, but the entire staff made what felt like a terrifying situation completely relaxing for me.

Dr. Valerie Antoine-Gustave is amazing as always! I am so grateful for her throughout my entire journey to getting healthy. She is just so warm, caring, and full of light.

Dr. Singh, the anesthesiologist, was incredible. Having never had anesthesia before, I was terrified, but he talked me down from freaking out. He was so kind, sympathetic, and relieved so much of my stress.

Nurse Alph was also amazing! The way he inserts a needle! He needs to teach a class! He did such a fantastic job that I didn’t feel a single thing, and it was quick and easy. That man deserves a raise!

I wish I had gotten the names of the entire nursing staff and front desk because every single person was so compassionate and attentive. I walked in terrified, but it turned out to be the easiest process imaginable. Thank you to everyone at Liberty Endoscopy Center, God bless you all!

-Shada

docs.text:

docs.title: Review of Zen Dentistry - FiDi
docs.text:
Google review of Zen Dentistry - FiDi (1 out of 5, by Natalia Le, 7 months ago): Maybe they are ok just for regular cleanings, but I had a really bad experience trying to replace my retainer. I have had a retainer for years that has done a good job of keeping my teeth straight. They told me I grind my teeth at night (I confirmed this is not true from my partner) and encouraged me to get a night guard. I came in to get the night guard fitted. It took one hour for them to fit it to my mouth because the 3D model the night guard was made from was broken. I repeatedly said that I was concerned about it not being made to fit my mouth, and they told me it would take time to adjust but I could come back if it didn’t fit. The night guard made my teeth crooked and my gums sore, even after 3 weeks where I hoped it was just my mouth adjusting. I came back to talk to them about this and to get my chart so that I could switch to a new dentist. It took one hour for them to do this, when they said the only option was to re-scan everything to get a new retainer.

They also told me I needed some injection that was meant to kill bacteria. I got those shots for $200 after copay but now am doubting whether I needed it at all.

The dental hygienist was also pretty unprofessional, kept asking me out even after I said I was dating someone.

docs.title: Review of Alba Dry Cleaners & Tailoring
docs.text:
Google review of Alba Dry Cleaners & Tailoring (5 out of 5, by Vivian Ly, 5 months ago): I would actually give them a 8/5 if I could! They got a tragic pizza grease stain out of a Blueberry trench for a reasonable price.

I was carrying a pizza box home far away from my coat and at one point, I looked down and all of the grease from a closed box had poured all over my trench coat. I called seven different dry cleaners. Most were unhelpful, and threw out insane prices the moment they heard Burburry. I had a shop quote me $245 as a starting point, and tell me that there were no guarantees.

I walked into Alba, and the staff just said they would handle it and if they couldn’t get it out, I didn’t need to pay. They didn’t try to alarm me, or make things seem worse than they were like every other place. They kept it really simple, and asked if I was willing to give them a chance. I’m deeply appreciative of how quickly they got it out, how easy they made the process, and that they even delivered the coat back to my apartment for $45. I couldn’t recommend this place over and over again and will definitely be coming back.

docs.title: Review of Alba Dry Cleaners & Tailoring
docs.text: Google review of Alba Dry Cleaners & Tailoring (5 out of 5, by Stephanie Miller, 3 months ago): Thank you Alba Dry Cleaners! My son is with the US Coast Guard and was in town for fleet week for the 4th of July. He's been on a boat for several weeks and needed to do his laundry/have clean uniforms, but his time in port was limited and on a holiday weekend. We were able to drop his items off on Sunday morning on a holiday weekend and were promised everything would be ready in 24 hours. We came back the next day and everything was done, as promised. They took great care of his laundry and it allowed our family the chance to spend time with our son while he was in port rather than at a laundromat doing laundry. We are so thankful for the great service and care that was given!

The moment someone mentions needing a dry cleaner or tailoring, Alba is always the first place I recommend. Their service and quality have made them my go-to for years.

Google review of G & G Cleaners (1 out of 5, by Blue Gaming, 2 years ago): If I could give zero stars, I would. My experience with G and G Cleaners was nothing short of a scammy disaster from start to finish. I brought in a simple skirt for a basic hem, expecting professional service and reasonable pricing. What I got was an absolute rip-off and a masterclass in bait-and-switch tactics.

First, they quoted me a modest price for the work, which seemed fair at $40. But when I came to pick up the skirt, the price had *magically* doubled! The excuse? Some nonsense about “additional adjustments” that were never discussed or authorized. I challenged the inflated price, but they stood their ground, refusing to release the skirt until I paid up. They know exactly what they’re doing—hold your items hostage and extort as much money as they can.

But it gets worse. When I finally got the skirt back (after begrudgingly paying the absurd fee), I discovered the quality of work was atrocious. Crooked stitches, uneven hemline—honestly, I’ve seen better craftsmanship from a first-day sewing student. It’s clear they couldn’t care less about delivering quality, just cashing in.

To top it all off, the owner’s attitude was condescending and downright rude. He dismissed my concerns and acted as if I should be grateful he even deigned to work on my skirt. Save yourself the trouble (and a lot of money) and steer clear of this place. They’re not tailors—they’re con artists in disguise.

Google review of Daily Bubble Laundromat Inc. (1 out of 5, by Jennifer Bath, 4 months ago): I was surprised by the positive reviews for this place, because our experience was deeply concerning. We suspected our clothes were not actually being washed - items came back smelling like fabric softener but not clean, and clothes with stain remover on them still had the stain remover residue, which came right off when we washed them ourselves.

So we tested it. On a second visit, we deliberately added stain remover to three items in a large load before drop-off. None of the stain remover had been washed off when we got the clothes back - stain remover dissolves immediately on contact with water, so if these items had been through a wash cycle, it would have come off. It did not. The clothes just smelled like fabric softener, masking the fact they had not been cleaned at all.

To make matters worse, we had left quarters at the bottom of our bag from a previous trip - they were gone when we got our clothes back.

To their credit, they did wash our undergarments properly. But we cannot recommend this laundromat for a full-service wash. If you need clean clothes, find a self-service laundromat - we found a great one in Chinatown.

There's other, cheaper laundromats near by that I now go to. I've had nothing but awful experiences with the workers and the machines, and for literally no justifiable reason.

I've had a worker stand over me watching me put my laundry into the machines and micromanage how much to put in each washer  and dryer, from start to finish, until I paid. I've had another lady refuse to give me my wash and fold until I gave them a higher tip- on top of realizing some of my clothes got discolored from their service. I've had gum and sticky substances stuck to my clothes because the machines are not well maintained. Anything that I could have go wrong has gone wrong with this place multiple times per year. On top of that, it's so expensive for the area, when there is a cleaner and more modern laundromat up the block on Mott St. I hate to give negative reviews, but it's just not worth the risk of using this place.

Google review of Soho Dry Cleaning (1 out of 5, by Brianna Torres, 4 months ago): This place seriously seriously sucks and is incredibly beyond unprofessional. As per their door and what the workers there say, they are open until 6pm Monday through Friday. I find it to be RIDICULOUS that by 5:58 the place is locked and the woman working had already left the store. This was confirmed by a worker who was outside and had been outside saying that the women left ~5 minutes prior. If your hours are until 6, you should be open until 6. That’s bare minimum. To pay $60 for laundry and then have them not even be open when you need to pick it up. Wow. I would not have dropped by laundry off there before a vacation if I had known I would not be able to pick it up within actual store hours.

Also to add feedback here following their review - I still arrived minutes before 6pm. How could staff complete closing process and be completely vacated from the store ~5 minutes before the closing time that’s listed. That is still leaving earlier and not aligned with the hours listed on the door or on my pick up receipt. If I arrived even at 6:02 I would be completely understanding of the fact that I arrived after the store was closed but I was there before 6. It was lights out, door locked, empty store BEFORE 6. Not someone in there closing up which would’ve understood.

Google review of White On White Cleaners (1 out of 5, by Whitney Owens, 8 months ago): ****UNFORTUNATE UPDATE*****significant financial loss and a great deal of inconvenience

I am very disappointed in recent service provided by White on White Dry Cleaners. After months as a regular customer, I began noticing a severe decline in quality and eventually damage. I brought in several high-end items that were in excellent condition, and when they were returned to me, multiple pieces were visibly damaged. Fabrics were ruined, colors were faded, and some items were no longer wearable.

Even more frustrating is the lack of accountability from Marco or his superiors. Rather than acknowledge the issue or offer a fair resolution, I was met with indifference and little effort to make things right. As of now, they have still not rectified the situation and are "waiting on a response" from management. When you trust a cleaner with expensive clothing, you expect professional care and responsibility if something goes wrong.

Unfortunately, this experience resulted in a significant financial loss (Nearly $2,000) and a great deal of inconvenience. I would strongly encourage anyone considering this business to think carefully before entrusting them with important garments. I will not be returning. We are still waiting on a proper resolution.

_____________________________________________

Marco and his team are responsive and have delivered for us consistently and reliably over the past 6 months! We moved away from another local cleaner due to the amount of plastic being used and quality of cleaning. Marco took care to onboard us quickly, honor our request for minimal plastic use, and goes above and beyond to pick up and deliver orders on time for us! Absolutely recommend!

Google review of Kelly Hair Salon (3 out of 5, by Cindy Wang (森碟的日常), 6 months ago): My family of four have been loyal customers here for years. We've tried most of the barbers at this salon and they've all been wonderful. Until today. Until Peter.

My husband came in for an American crop perm. We brought clear reference photos showing exactly how it should be done — foil sections, not rods. Peter (older, long hair) looked at the photos and ignored them entirely, using large cylindrical rods instead.

I was there and stopped him halfway through, asking why he wasn't using foil like in the photos. Peter said it wouldn't matter, the result would be the same.

Spoiler: it was not the same. We walked out with a full woolly perm.

This isn't a case of stylistic interpretation. These are two completely different techniques that produce completely different results. Peter either didn't know how to do a foil perm and didn't say so, or he knew and decided to do it his way anyway. Neither is acceptable.

And then — we were charged full price. $20 over the posted pricing on the window, which Peter apparently tacked on himself. Wrong result, dismissed concerns, and an unexplained upcharge. Save yourself the time, the money, and the bad hair day.

💡 One genuine tip: ask for Linlin or Ming — both excellent female barbers. There's also a male barber who sits on the right side of the shop, gray hair, mid to late 40s — forgot his name but he's the real deal. These three are the best in the shop by far.

Google review of Drybar (1 out of 5, by Mariah Gajadhar, 6 months ago): 1 star

I’ve been to Drybar multiple times, and this visit was extremely disappointing.

While I was still well within my scheduled appointment time (with about 20–30 minutes remaining), a staff member who was not my stylist and not the manager approached me and told me that if my hair “took longer,” I might be charged extra she said this in a very unprofessional way. This had never been mentioned at check-in. The way it was said felt reprimanding, as if my hair itself was creating a problem, which was confusing and inappropriate given that my service was still in progress and on time.

It also became clear the real issue was that another client wanted the stylist who was currently working on my hair—even though other stylists were available. Instead of managing that internally, I was approached mid-service and made to feel like I was holding things up. I was repeatedly told “it’s not your fault,” which only made the interaction more confusing, because there was no reason for me to be involved at all.

To be clear, the stylist actually doing my hair was professional and did a great job. My concern is with the staff member who interrupted my appointment to discuss timing and possible extra charges that had never been disclosed beforehand. I was left wondering why someone who was neither my stylist nor the manager felt it was appropriate to address me this way in the middle of my service.

I asked to speak to a manager. I was ultimately not charged extra, but the situation should never have happened in the first place. Clients should not be pressured or made to feel rushed because someone else prefers their stylist.

Very disappointing experience. I expected better professionalism. ✂️ I spent 77 dollars to be told my shoulder hair length was taking too long meanwhile other stylist was taking there time

Google review of Drybar (1 out of 5, by Alyssa, a year ago): I specifically reached out to the Tribeca location before booking because I have very thick 4C hair, and I wanted to confirm that someone on the team would be comfortable working with my texture. I was assured that everyone at the salon was experienced with natural hair, so I booked immediately and even included a note in my appointment about my hair type to avoid any surprises.

When I arrived, however, I was placed with Arlene, and the experience was extremely disappointing. She rushed me to the bowl and gave me the quickest, roughest wash I have ever received. At the blow dryer, she immediately made negative comments about my hair’s thickness instead of taking the time to properly detangle. She used a blow dryer attachment and brush in a careless, rushed manner that felt both disrespectful and unprofessional.

Throughout the process, she continued making comments about the “strength” required for my hair, told me things like “If you can’t keep your head still this is going to take hours”, and repeatedly pushed or held my head roughly. It was painful and impossible to stay still given how aggressively she was handling my hair. At one point, while separating sections, she was essentially ripping strands apart.

I was so uncomfortable and disheartened by the service that I almost walked out mid-appointment, hair half done. It is absolutely unacceptable to place clients with stylists who are clearly not capable—or willing—to work with their hair type. If a stylist cannot or does not want to work with certain textures, that should be acknowledged upfront. But to pair me with someone who not only lacked the skill but also displayed visible frustration at having to do my hair was deeply unprofessional and disrespectful.

docs.title: Review of Life Time
docs.text:
Google review of Life Time (3 out of 5, by Christine Myer, a year ago): I enjoy my time here and this is my favorite gym in the city. The amenities are fantastic, the staff is friendly, and the facility is spacious and thoughtfully designed. I truly consider it my second home, playground, and happy place. I appreciate the separation of the men's and women's sauna, steam room, and whirlpool, which adds to the overall experience. After a good workout, I love to unwind with a hydro massage and relax in the whirlpool. A big thank you to Matt, Chase, and Dusty for their consistently warm greetings!

However, I’ve rated my experience three stars because there are areas for improvement.

***Recently, I encountered a billing issue and brought it to the attention of one of the concierge staff. He mentioned he would contact the manager, and I followed up the next day, only to be told it was resolved. Almost a week later, I still hadn’t seen any refund or email confirmation regarding the adjustment. After a third inquiry, I connected with Chase, who promptly addressed the issue. This left me wondering about the responsiveness of the initial staff member.

***Additionally, I faced a situation where one of the trainers canceled my appointment without prior notice. This felt unprofessional, but I appreciate Peter for reaching out and resolving the matter quickly.

***I've also noticed that sometimes the staff at the cafe can get a little loud, chatting and laughing as if they were at home. Although it’s great to see camaraderie, it can be distracting while I’m trying to get some work done.

***Lastly, I believe there could be improvements in cleanliness, especially in the women’s restrooms.

Overall, I love this place and I'm hopeful for these adjustments, as it would make a great experience even better!

docs.title: Review of Barry's TriBeCa
docs.text:
Google review of Barry's TriBeCa (5 out of 5, by Bunker Blake, 3 months ago): Before Barry’s became a global fitness cult, it was, for me, a specific downtown New York initiation. Tribeca at One York was my first doorway in, delayed by Hurricane Sandy, and walking into that studio felt like the beginning of something. I’m pretty sure my first class was with Rebecca Kennedy, and I left blown away, humbled, and very close to throwing up.

Barry’s earns its reputation the hard way: inside the Red Room, the workout becomes a negotiation with your lungs, legs, and pride. It is still brutal, and it takes commitment, usually several classes close together, before you feel even halfway decent in there. Life and budget have kept me away for 18 months, so if I walked into class tomorrow, I know exactly how humbled I would be. The work is punishing, intentional, and never cruel.

The running has always set Barry’s apart: Woodway treadmills made it smoother, sharper, and more athletic than anything else I was doing. I still remember Rebecca using “treaders,” a funny little word that later disappeared from the instructor lexicon and somehow still makes me nostalgic. My favorite class was Butt and Legs; I’m sure Abs and Ass has a smart rationale, but that old format had magic: visible results, better running, real strength, and a more athletic body.

Noho took what hooked me at Tribeca and showed where the brand was going. The studio was larger, the floor plan was better, and the experience felt like the prototype for how Barry’s could scale while keeping its heat. It felt perfectly appropriate that Barry’s Noho sat across from Indochine, as if downtown glamour, discipline, sweat, and scene had agreed to share the same block. Tribeca gave me the origin story; Noho gave me the blueprint.

Barry Jay once said something close to this: Barry’s was like a nightclub without the drugs, alcohol, and traps that can come with those environments. That has always felt right to me: the dark room, the music, the bodies, and the energy dialed up and down like treadmill speed. Barry’s carried me through marathon training, brutal work seasons, and bosses I will be diplomatic about here. More than once, it helped me keep getting up and keep going when life made that incredibly difficult.

Some mornings, the Red Room did more for my sanity than coffee, a calendar full of high profile meetings, or a well meaning pep talk ever could. I would run, lift, sweat through all of my clothes, and walk back into the city feeling more like myself. Watching the brand grow has been its own pleasure: Barry’s retained instructor quality across markets, turned front desk talent into coaches, earned recognition in smaller cities, and moved its merch upmarket. I worked uptown around the investment circles that eventually backed Barry’s, and I remember seeing the pitch book before North Castle’s investment. Barry Jay’s class at Tribeca, and the original West Hollywood studio with beige linoleum tile and tiny beige lockers, reminded me that the workout built the brand before the brand became glossy.

Instructor shoutout, because the people are the product (alphabetical by first name):

Alycia S, Amanda A, Amber R, Ashley P, Barry J, Bobby M, Brady D, Brendan T, Casey F, Chris H, Erick W, Jake G, Jason R, Jay C, Jennifer S, Joe A, Josey G, Layla L, Lindsey C, Luke S, Matt G, Matt N, Matty M, Max K, Michael P, Mike E, Natalie R, Niv Z, Omri R, Patrick F, Rebecca K, Sarah O, Tiana O, Todd M, and William P.

This is my South of 14th Street thank you note, even knowing other studios and instructors deserve recognition. Barry’s kept me current, connected to younger city life, and loyal to excellent coaching inside a room full of people quietly deciding not to quit. Google review of Planet Fitness (2 out of 5, by Ethan Linton, 5 months ago): I’d like to share my recent experience at Planet Fitness, because honestly, I’m still trying to make sense of it. I was doing a progressive deactivation exercise — a completely legitimate relaxation technique where you lie down, breathe deeply, and release muscle tension. Nothing strange, nothing dangerous, nothing that affects anyone.

But apparently, at this gym, seeing a man lying on his back doing slow, deep breathing is just too much for the staff to handle.
Maybe it looked too peaceful.
Maybe they thought I was summoning ancient spirits.
Or maybe someone simply couldn’t stand the idea of a member being more relaxed than they are.

An employee came over and abruptly interrupted me, pulling me out of the exercise to inform me that “sleeping on the floor is prohibited.” Interesting, considering I wasn’t sleeping. But of course, why observe, listen, or use basic judgment when you can just repeat a rule like a robot with no context.

The best part is that Planet Fitness advertises itself as the famous “No Judgment Zone.”
Apparently, that slogan only applies when it’s convenient, because judging a Black Card member for doing a harmless relaxation exercise seems perfectly acceptable.

If the policy is truly “No Judgment,” it would be great if the staff practiced it too.
Because if the most shocking thing happening in the gym is someone breathing slowly on the floor, then the problem isn’t me… it’s the lack of common sense.

Google review of Asphalt Green - Battery Park City Campus (2 out of 5, by Olivia Thomas, 11 months ago): The gym seems to focus primarily on its kids’ programs and pool facilities, which appear to be the main revenue drivers. Unfortunately, this leaves the fitness area itself somewhat neglected. While the membership price ($75/month) is reasonable, the gym offers only the bare essentials for effective workouts.

Equipment maintenance is slow—broken benches can take months to repair or replace. During peak hours, the limited number of machines means everything is often in use, forcing members to wait rather than adapt their workouts.

Unlike many gyms that oversupply treadmills, Asphalt Green has the opposite issue. With only five treadmills, they’re almost always occupied during busy times, making functional or interval training difficult. Meanwhile, there’s an excess of bikes and ellipticals that rarely see use.

docs.title: Review of Asphalt Green - Battery Park City Campus
docs.text:
Google review of Asphalt Green - Battery Park City Campus (2 out of 5, by Enes Libohova, a year ago): The gym overall caters to their kids' program and the pool, which are the money making of the business. The gym alone, although decently priced ($75/month) is neglected and has just the bare minimum for your workouts.

Benches break and it takes months to be either repaired or replaced.

Due to limited machine availability, during peak hours all machines are frequently in use at the same time, leaving no choice but to wait rather than adjust the workout.

I often complain about the exaggerated supply of treadmills in commercial gyms. At Asphalt Green is the opposite. With only 5 treadmills they are consistently occupied during peak hours, disrupting functional and interval training. Meanwhile, the numerous bikes and ellipticals remain underutilized.

The absence of machines like a Smith machine, chest/shoulder press, and incline bench has limited our ability to complete well-rounded strength workouts.

Overall, it's OK for casual gym goers - but if you are serious about your gym and strength training routine this place will quickly make you feel constrained. The neglecting of the equipment also just adds to the overall 'unwelcomeness' of the space.

The floor staff is nice, though.

Because of these reasons we had to cancel our membership, and we found a more suitable place to our needs.

docs.text:
Google review of PureGym FiDi (3 out of 5, by Tal Sela, 3 months ago): I would say this gym is honestly a solid 4 out of 5, but I am giving it 3 stars, and here is why.

If we take 5 stars as the ideal gym, the first half-star comes off for the broken showers. There are only four showers in the men’s locker room, and two of them are broken. In one of them, even the light no longer works. In my opinion, that is simply not serious.

I am also taking off one full star for the way the space is organized. For those who do not know, this gym has two floors: the first floor is a bit smaller, and the second floor is a bit bigger. The issue is that there is an unreasonable number of cardio machines. There is already a large cardio area on the second floor, but for some reason, half of the first floor is also taken up by cardio equipment.

To be clear, even during peak hours on a Monday evening, the upstairs cardio area is not completely full. The downstairs cardio area is almost never busy - usually there are just a couple of people there.

This could be fixed in a very simple way: either remove the cardio area from the first floor completely and replace it with a proper stretching area, a free weights area, kettlebells, and similar equipment, or reduce the upstairs cardio area and use that space for free weights instead.

The final half-star comes off for the free weights area. Honestly, it is not serious. This is probably the most popular area in the entire gym, yet it is squeezed into a small cramped room where it is difficult to even breathe properly. Because of that, it is constantly hot and the air feels stale. I really do not understand why this area is so poorly arranged.

To summarize: I am giving this gym 3 stars specifically because the space is badly organized. At the same time, I understand that my preferences may be specific, and maybe for the average gym user this amount of cardio equipment is fine. So objectively, the gym is probably closer to a 4. But for me personally, because of the poor layout and the free weights area, it is a 3.

UPDATE:
As of today, 3 out of 4 showers are not working - only one shower is usable.

I also would not put much trust in the owner’s response saying that repairs are supposedly planned. The reason I stopped going to the Bryant Park location was exactly this kind of situation: I waited around 8 months for the promised renovation of the lifting / squat area, and it never happened. Eventually, I had to switch to this location.

docs.title: Review of Bright Horizons at DUMBO
docs.text: Google review of Bright Horizons at DUMBO (5 out of 5, by Lauren Brenner, 2 years ago): We love the Dumbo BH. docs.title: Review of Bright Horizons at DUMBO
docs.text: Google review of Bright Horizons at DUMBO (5 out of 5, by Erica Virtue, 5 years ago): Our daughter started at Bright Horizons as an infant and has since graduated to the toddler room. Our experience has been excellent and it’s been great for her development. Her teachers are all very warm and caring and the school is very communicative. We really enjoy seeing photos and updates through the day via the app. She is super excited to go to school every day to see her friends and teachers.

docs.title: Review of Bright Horizons at DUMBO
docs.text: Google review of Bright Horizons at DUMBO (5 out of 5, by Leland James, 5 years ago): We started our daughter at Bright Horizons Dumbo when she was just four months old. We had looked at several daycare options at the time and there was just no comparison. Through every stage of development, they have led with a results driven and empathetic approach to make sure every stage of her ongoing transition was handled with the utmost personal care. We moved her to a separate Bright Horizons location just before her first birthday and found the care to be universal across locations. When the pandemic hit, the centers closed and we were heartbroken for the mere fact that she was losing a network of support that had allowed her to make incredible cognitive strides. When the Dumbo center reopened, we were quick to return but with caution. Every parent in that moment was rightfully concerned with making sure safety was not compromised for the sake of child care relief. Bright Horizons’ leadership team was so committed to ensuring a safe and supportive environment that our concerns were subdued instantly. Our daughter continues to shine as a result of her experience and is incredibly emotionally and cognitively mature for her age. We know that her personal success is a direct result of the hard work and compassion displayed by the entire staff at her center. They have become like an extension of our family and all of us, especially our daughter, could not be happier. I fully encourage any parent to trust the Bright Horizons community to provide an unrivaled standard of excellence for their child, especially the team at the Dumbo location.

docs.title: Review of Bright Horizons at DUMBO

docs.text:
Google review of Kinder Prep Montessori Nursery & Preschool in Brooklyn Heights (5 out of 5, by Natalie Li, 2 months ago): We had the best experience sending our infant/1-year-old to Kinder Prep Montessori. It's such a warm, caring place, and my daughter was so well cared for--she came home happy every single day.

The activities are unmatched: circle time, cooking class, music class, and they provide food too. I especially loved that the kids got to go outside every day, weather permitting--circle time on a picnic blanket in the park, swings, exploring. It's the best, and honestly hard to replicate that experience elsewhere in Brooklyn.

Ms. Natalia and really all the teachers in the Ducklings class are so loving and caring. Ms. Tina in admin was always organized and responsive, and made the transition from the infant to toddler classroom so smooth.

We sadly decided to switch daycares to a place a 1-minute walk from our apartment, purely for convenience--but we have nothing but the best things to say about Kinder Prep. We will miss it!

docs.text: Google review of Kinder Prep Montessori Nursery & Preschool in Brooklyn Heights (5 out of 5, by Sarah Thomas-Polak, 3 months ago): We have been so pleased with the teachers, staff, and educational experience that our daughter has received at Kinder Prep @ Brooklyn Bridge Park over the past 8 months. She is happy, thriving, and absolutely loves going to school. We appreciate the level of communication we receive from the KP team as well as the deep engagement our child has through the Montessori approach. We are thrilled with how much she has grown already and how her mental, social/emotional and physical skills continue to evolve along with her personality. We trust the KP team and are most grateful for the care our child receives. Thank you, KP team!

docs.title: Review of Vivvi Tribeca | Child Care and Early Learning
docs.text:
Google review of Vivvi Tribeca | Child Care and Early Learning (5 out of 5, by Nancy Flewelling, a year ago): To all the new parents out there on the fence about Vivvi vs. another daycare vs. a nanny… I enthusiastically, wholeheartedly recommend Vivvi. I give it a 12 out of 10. Every single person who works there is so kind and professional, and they take incredible care of our daughter.

We get photos all day long, and her teachers always have such fun, creative activities planned for them during the day (even in our daughter’s infant class). Our 9 month old lights up every day we arrive to Vivvi, and you can just tell the rest of the kids are excited to be there.

The location itself is clean, bright, and airy, and you won’t find better hours anywhere else in the city. We wouldn’t even consider moving to another apartment that wasn’t close to a Vivvi.

docs.title: Review of Vivvi Tribeca | Child Care and Early Learning
docs.text:
Google review of Vivvi Tribeca | Child Care and Early Learning (5 out of 5, by Kelly Leach, a year ago): Vivvi has been a cornerstone in my son’s life since he started there as a six-month-old. Now, at 2.5, I can clearly see the impact of their thoughtful curriculum and nurturing environment. My son is curious, confident, and—if I’m being honest—further along in his abilities compared to some of his peers in traditional daycare settings or with nannies. I truly believe this is because of the “Vivvi difference.”

The teachers at Vivvi don’t just care for the children—they see them. Serena, the head of school, is exceptional: hands-on, approachable, and deeply committed to every family. The owners, Charlie and Ben, aren’t distant figures—they’re actively involved in the community, creating a warm and inclusive atmosphere. I’ve even met an incredible group of parents, and now our kids have regular playdates after school and on weekends.

Recently, my son and I experienced a deeply traumatic event. In that moment, Vivvi became so much more than a school. The owners, leadership, teachers, and entire community were a lifeline. Their compassion, love, and unwavering support carried us through one of the hardest times of our lives, and for that, I will always be grateful.

Choosing where to send your child can feel overwhelming. I know I made the right choice with Vivvi. It’s not just a school—it’s a family. I feel incredibly lucky to have found them, and I can’t imagine a better place for my child to grow, learn, and thrive.

docs.title: Review of The Learning Experience - Manhattan
docs.text:
Google review of The Learning Experience - Manhattan (5 out of 5, by Merritt Thomas, 8 months ago): We couldn’t be happier with TLE - it is a wonderful nurturing environment for babies to pre-K.  TLE is impeccably run and led by a wonderful team, headed by Ms. Jessica, the director, who is on top of everything going on in the school.  Teachers are high quality - kind, attentive, and invested in the children… many have been here for years, which speaks volumes.  Communication with parents is excellent, with clear weekly emails, and daily photos that give real insight into what the children are doing and how their days are going.  The entire administration knows the names of every child, and greets them by name each morning as they walk in.

The kids are constantly engaged in creative activities - they have hands-on learning every day and are doing fun messy art projects as toddlers, and running little experiments in 3K and pre-K.  They are taken outside to run and play every day, weather-permitting.  During the year, there are high quality enrichment classes brought in to supplement the curriculum, including special science instruction, theater classes, and dance classes.  During the summer camp, there is even more - soccer instruction and magic and water Fridays etc.

Holidays are thoughtfully celebrated throughout the year and birthdays are a cause for special celebration!  The staff will help you set up decorations and teachers will throw a little party for the kids.  This is particularly great given the expense of children’s parties in Manhattan!  As a bonus, the annual “school photos” are beautifully done by a fantastic independent photographer - we use ours for our holiday card every year!

TLE is a real community for families - parents say hi to each other in the hallways and on the local playground in the evening and weekends.  It’s a very international community, which is wonderful.  TLE is just a real gem - the kind of warm loving environment you want for your child - our son has attended since he was 18 months and he is a thriving 4 year-old.  We couldn’t recommend TLE more highly.

docs.text:
Google review of NY Preschool & Kids Club – Brooklyn Heights (1 out of 5, by Brooklyn Parent, 9 months ago): This post is strictly about the business practices of the administration and not the actual educators who appear to be excellent:

1. Paid full tuition for upcoming semester. Withdrew before school started. School is refusing to refund any of the tuition despite stating that other families will take the seat and in violation of the refund framework of the contract.

2. School is not upfront about actual chances of being selected to attend DOE funded 3K there.

Repeatedly implied that it was guaranteed, whereas in reality people have said that over a third of the students do not get a seat as the number of 3K seats are significantly less than 2K seats.

3. The large number of reviews about struggling to get payments or refunds should have been a red flag. Other schools do not have these kinds of complaints.

docs.title: Review of Buckle My Shoe Preschool
docs.text:
Google review of Buckle My Shoe Preschool (5 out of 5, by David Kullmann, 9 years ago): (Please note I posted the same review on Yelp!, also, to respect privacy of other parents photos uploaded are only my child)

Buckle My Shoe is more than just a day care, it's an early childhood development program that you'll cherish for the rest of your life. My son has attended Buckle My Shoe for 1.5 years (he's currently enrolled in his 2nd of two full year programs and attended summer school.) He started as a 9 month old in September of 2015.

In the infant class (3m-12m) the children have tummy time, explore new materials, colors, and shapes, learn to crawl and start to stand. Everyday the teachers write a report on what the class did which they post online (to a private, password protected location). They also post 50-100 photos per day of all the children to a private, password protected photo account. I have saved over a hundred heart-warming photos of my son learning, laughing, and playing.

The kids also make arts and crafts together. Gluing, finger painting, and more. We get to take home dozens of gifts that our son made for us at the school over the last 18 months.

In the toddler class everyone is walking and starting to talk. The kids go on field trips to trick or treat, cut a Christmas tree, see the fire department and firetrucks, and go to the park. While in school they do arts and crafts, learn Spanish and French, sing songs with a guitarist, and play together with toys that help them learn and develop (building train tracks, stacking blocks and legos, ABC's and 123's, reading books.)

Parents are welcome anytime and we often drop in if we get off work early. Our son loves the school so much he refuses to leave when we pick him up!

After looking at over a dozen schools, and visiting half that, I was nervous to pick a school for our little baby. I could not be happier that I chose Buckle My Shoe. BMS has become an invaluable part of my sons educational, social, and physical development. At this point, I don't know if I could live without them.

docs.title: Review of Buckle My Shoe Preschool
docs.text: Google review of Buckle My Shoe Preschool (5 out of 5, by Delphine Colette Ahl, 7 years ago): This is our fourth year at Buckle My Shoe West Village and we couldn’t be any happier! We feel it is the perfect place to get your children ready for Kindergarten. Their Reggio Emilia philosophy is on point and we feel it is the perfect setting for young children to dive into self-discovery and explore their curiosities and passions by fostering creativity. Everyday the Centers are perfectly thought out and organized with a real purpose in mind. The teachers serve as wonderful guides to the children throughout the discovery process. The environment is warm and inviting and should separation ever be an issue for your child, they are more than happy to have you stick around for as long as you feel is necessary. We love how our children blossomed at BMS and to this day our eldest still thinks of BMS as her happy place.

docs.title: Review of Buckle My Shoe Preschool
docs.text: Google review of Buckle My Shoe Preschool (5 out of 5, by Amy Golding, 11 years ago): My son is in the 3's class in the West Village and my daughter is in the 1's class in Tribeca. We absolutely love it, and so do they! From the minute you walk in, you feel at home and like you are entering a magical environment. I was grateful to find the Reggio Emilia inspired philosophy and the child-centered approach to curriculum and instruction at BMS. The children actively play and come home messy every day - and the depth and breadth of what they learn through that process is incredible. The teachers are fantastic and well trained. The head teachers all have a Masters in Education and they participate in staff development with Reggio experts to push themselves even further throughout the year. Teachers are always on hand to address any concerns and to support in the many areas that all parents struggle with - potty training, developmental stages, eating, napping and more. What I love the most is how creative the lessons are - designed to educate, foster socialization and create a lifelong love of learning. The parents, children and teachers come together to create an amazingly loving preschool that fosters incredible learning for the students and feels like a family. It is a home away from home!

docs.title: Review of Bright Horizons at 20 Pine
docs.text: Google review of Bright Horizons at 20 Pine (5 out of 5, by Ashley Gray, 2 years ago): The best decision we could have made for our daughter! We enrolled her at Bright Horizons 20 Pine when she was 6 months and our experience has been so wonderful. The teachers and administrative staff are so kind and helpful. She gets exposed to so many activities and experiences that we cannot give her at home. Her classmates and their families are also really great. It is a really lovely, clean, and safe environment, we are so grateful. We especially love seeing her progress throughout the day and staying in close touch with her teachers through the app. Thank you, Bright Horizons!

docs.title: Review of Bright Horizons at 20 Pine
docs.text:
Google review of Bright Horizons at 20 Pine (5 out of 5, by Michelle Gottlieb, 6 years ago): After a rough start at another day care, we decided to enroll our 4 month old daughter at 20 Pine. We were really nervous to try another day care, especially one that required a commute from Brooklyn, but we are so happy that we decided to send our daughter here. From our initial visit to our meeting with her teacher, we knew that she would be in good hands.
Jessica and her team are AMAZING at what they do. Everyone at 20 Pine knows my daughter's name and they treat our entire family with warmth, compassion and professionalism. Working with babies is HARD and her teachers are incredibly patient, loving and interactive. They clearly love what they do and we have seen how much our daughter has grown in the few months that she has been there. We love the Bright Horizons app where we can get updates on what she's doing all day. You can get alerts when your baby has a bottle, wakes from a nap, etc. but more importantly you get photos of your child throughout the day. As a working mom, it makes me feel better knowing what she's doing while I'm away.

This is our first child and it was really hard to leave her to go back to work but it is such a relief to drop her off every day knowing that she is being cared for by such amazing people. Everyone from the teachers to the office manager to the director to the support staff here are wonderful. I can't recommend 20 Pine enough. I promise it's worth the ferry/subway ride to Manhattan for other Brooklyn parents looking for a day care for their children.

docs.title: Review of Bright Horizons at 20 Pine
docs.text: Google review of Bright Horizons at 20 Pine (5 out of 5, by Tina Wadhwa, 7 years ago): My toddler had a great experience at Bright Horizons at 20 Pine. I also loved receiving the daily updates with pictures of my child and the activities she engaged it. We had a wonderful experience with Bright Horizons at 20 pine and I would definitely recommend it to other families looking for wonderful care.

docs.title: Review of KinderCare FiDi NYC
docs.text:
Google review of KinderCare FiDi NYC (5 out of 5, by Shane B, 4 months ago): We had a great experience at this KinderCare location.

My daughter was here for about a year, in both the infant and the toddler classrooms. The best things about this location are (1) the hours, which stretch about as long as any daycare around (7:30 to 6:30), (2) the App, on which you get lots of picture and video updates of your child throughout the day, and most importantly (3) the staff, who are very dedicated, caring, and competent. In particular, Marsha and Lizbeth were excellent. Even the 1 year olds do many educational and skill-building activities, and the "curriculum" feels orderly and well-designed. It's not just a bunch of kids in a room running around. During the year that my daughter was here, I did not hear of any parents moving their children to another daycare center.

Admittedly, it wasn't all great. The center closed one day for snow when public schools were still open, and that felt a little bit like a ripoff (of course we were still charged for the full week). They are vigilant about spotting rashes and taking temperatures, which is good for the health and safety of the kids, but can be frustrating when you are asked to pick up your kid and only take them back with a doctor's note when the concern is just a minor rash or a fever of 100.4. Presumably many other centers are the same way, because they can point to laws/regulations requiring this. They have also had a somewhat high level of turnover in administrative staff, but that has not impacted the day-to-day care that the kids get.

All in all, I would definitely recommend this center for infant/toddler care.

docs.title: Review of KinderCare FiDi NYC

docs.title: Review of KinderCare FiDi NYC
docs.text: Google review of KinderCare FiDi NYC (5 out of 5, by Serin Choi, 6 months ago): We sent our infant to KinderCare. They were so loving and caring. Our son really thrived and he lit up every time he saw his teachers in the morning.  The admin team was also excellent and communicative.

docs.title: Review of KinderCare FiDi NYC
docs.text:
Google review of KinderCare FiDi NYC (5 out of 5, by Emmanuelle Blain, a year ago): We joined Kindercare FiDi in 2022 and entrusted them with our children—first our daughter, then our son in 2024—each starting in the infant classroom at just 4.5 months old. The idea of leaving a baby with strangers was incredibly stressful, but the team’s warmth and kindness immediately put us at ease and gave us confidence in their care.
Emily, the executive director, has been leading the center with great professionalism and genuine care. The teachers are nurturing, attentive, and communicative—always checking in and sharing photos and videos that brighten our days. We’re especially grateful for the loving attention and support for our son as he transitions to the toddler classroom, and for the fun, enriching activities our daughter loves, from music and dance to animals, magic shows, and soccer.
We’re deeply thankful to the entire team for creating a kind, joyful environment and giving us peace of mind knowing our children are in safe and caring hands!

docs.title: Review of Golden Minds Prep
docs.text:
Google review of Golden Minds Prep (5 out of 5, by Anna-Ilona Semenova, 2 months ago): Our family absolutely loves this learning center! My daughter has been attending for the past two years, and she is genuinely excited to go every single day.

The variety of educational activities is truly outstanding. The children enjoy chess, checkers, karate, art classes, cooking classes, and many other enriching programs that help them learn, grow, and build confidence. The indoor playground is absolutely amazing—safe, spacious, and thoughtfully designed.

Another thing we truly appreciate is that the learning center has its own kitchen, where fresh meals are prepared daily using organic ingredients. Knowing that our daughter is eating nutritious, freshly made food is incredibly important to us and makes a real difference for a growing child.

We actually commute all the way from the Upper West Side because I truly believe this learning center is worth it. In my opinion, it would be very difficult to find another learning center in Manhattan that offers the same level of education, care, engaging activities, and overall quality.

The teachers and staff create a warm, supportive environment where children feel happy, confident, and inspired to learn. Choosing this learning center has been one of the best decisions we’ve made for our daughter, and I wholeheartedly recommend it to any family looking for an exceptional early childhood education program.

docs.title: Review of Golden Minds Prep
docs.text:
Google review of Golden Minds Prep (5 out of 5, by minju Jeong, 9 months ago): Hands down the best daycare we've ever experienced!
I’ve sent my child to several highly-rated daycares, but this one is truly in a league of its own. (This is a 100% genuine review, not an ad!)

What sets this place apart is the exceptional quality of care. They provide organic meals, and the curriculum is outstanding. Beyond standard educational programs, they offer unique activities like karate, soccer, gardening, and cooking classes—experiences you rarely find elsewhere.

The facilities are also impressive. Each class has its own spacious, dedicated room, creating a very clean and pleasant environment for the kids. Additionally, their hours (8 AM to past 6 PM) are a lifesaver for working parents. I don’t usually write reviews, but I felt compelled to share how wonderful this place is. Highly recommended!

docs.text: Google review of The Washington Market School - Duane Street (5 out of 5, by Boundless Solutions, 3 months ago): We recently completed Pediatric CPR, AED, and First Aid training for the staff at WMS and were impressed by their level of participation and professionalism. Their team understands the importance of being prepared to respond in an emergency and approached the training with seriousness and dedication. Creating a safe environment for children requires ongoing effort, and this program has demonstrated a strong commitment to that responsibility. The staff actively engaged in hands-on skills practice and emergency response scenarios. Families should take comfort in knowing that this program values safety, preparedness, and continuous improvement.

docs.title: Review of The Washington Market School - Duane Street
docs.text: Google review of The Washington Market School - Duane Street (5 out of 5, by Jacqueline Connor, a year ago): I cannot think of a better nursery school experience than what The Washington Market School provides! Not only do the children love it, but the teachers and administration make parenting easier. One example was that my daughter has always been very talkative but her teachers quickly realized that she was having trouble communicating and so they suggested that we enroll Eloise in speech therapy. They also assisted us find an amazing speech therapist and regularly spoke to Eloise’s speech therapist to make sure they were continuing speech lessons in the classroom. Since then, Eloise’s pronunciation has drastically improved and she loves conversing with adults! So that is all to say thank you The Washington Market School for being so incredible!

docs.title: Review of The Washington Market School - Duane Street
docs.text: Google review of The Washington Market School - Duane Street (5 out of 5, by Dabrowski Family, 2 years ago): I am constantly in awe and continually impressed by The Washington Market School’s level of thoughtfulness, attention to detail, and care toward its children, families and community. Everyone from the teachers to the administrators and staff really cares about each child, and each child is embraced and celebrated for what makes them uniquely them. I think when someone cares about what they do, it really shows and is very much felt. The sense of warmth, kindness, and belonging is what immediately drew us to WMS and can be instantly felt upon walking into the school and classrooms. We have experienced firsthand the positive and powerful impact this environment has had on our daughter. At two years old, she loves to tell us her favorite day is Monday because she gets to go to school. The Washington Market School has not only instilled in her a love of learning, but also more joy, curiosity, compassion, and confidence. We could not have asked for a better preschool experience than the one at The Washington Market School.

docs.title: Review of The Washington Market School - Duane Street
docs.text:
Google review of The Washington Market School - Duane Street (5 out of 5, by Ashley Anderson, 3 years ago): My daughter attended The Washington Market School before we relocated to London for my husband’s job, and we would have undoubtedly extended her stay to the full three years had our circumstances allowed. As a parent and an experienced educator with over 12 years in the field, I can confidently say that our experience at WMS was nothing short of exceptional.
From the very first day, it was evident that WMS was more than just an educational institution. It was a place where our daughter felt not only loved but truly seen by all of her teachers. The dedication and passion of the teaching staff were palpable, and it made every drop-off and pick-up a heartwarming experience. The caring atmosphere that enveloped the school contributed immensely to her overall happiness and enthusiasm for learning.
One of the standout qualities of WMS is its ability to foster a sense of community among families. We were fortunate to find ourselves on a seemingly endless stream of playdates with other families in our daughter's class. These playdates blossomed into genuine friendships with other parents, creating a strong support network that extended beyond the classroom. The school's knack for uniting families is truly commendable and made us feel like we were part of something special.
The school consistently brought in authors, psychologists, and other experts to address topics relevant to our children's development. This not only enriched our understanding but also created a valuable platform for discussions and shared experiences among parents. For me, it was a testament to the school's commitment to the holistic well-being of our kiddos.
Leaving New York City was a bittersweet experience for us, primarily because of how deeply we had fallen in love with WMS. In just one year, we witnessed remarkable growth in our daughter. She emerged from her first year more social, independent, and confident. Every interaction I witnessed between my daughter and her teachers/administrators was incredibly nurturing and empowering.
We will forever cherish our time there, and we're immensely grateful for the lasting impact it has had on our family. If circumstances ever bring us back to New York City in time for our second daughter's nursery school years, there is no doubt in our minds that we will enthusiastically choose WMS once again.

NOTE: We sent our daughters to another Montessori school nearby for camp before moving to London because WMS was not taking 2 year olds this summer and the experience made me appreciate WMS even more. I was reminded of the special place WMS is -- every WMS teacher and administrator is warm and cares deeply about every kid.

docs.title: Review of The Washington Market School - Duane Street
docs.text:
Google review of The Washington Market School - Duane Street (5 out of 5, by Siqi Mou, 3 years ago): Our experience at WMS has been truly exceptional. We are continually amazed by the quality of education and care provided, and we couldn't be happier with our choice. Here are the key highlights that have made WMS stand out:

1. Outstanding Staff and Administration: The team at WMS, from teachers and administrators to security and maintenance, is top-notch. The school's commitment to excellence and communication has been outstanding. The genuine warmth, care, and kindness of the staff have left a lasting impression on our child.

2. Happy and Confident Children: The children at WMS are genuinely happy, and our son's progress in becoming more social and articulate in just a short time is remarkable. This reflects the nurturing and supportive environment provided by the school.

3. Comparative Excellence: Our prior experience with a toddler program only made us appreciate WMS even more. The school's quality, dedication, and overall environment surpass our previous experiences.

4. Strong Parent Community: WMS not only fosters a sense of belonging among children but also extends it to parents. We've formed close friendships within the parent community, which is a testament to the nurturing environment created by the school.

5. Thorough Exmissions Support: Although our child isn't yet at the age for exmissions, we've witnessed the thorough support WMS provides. Our friends' daughters who have gone through it are now thriving in top-tier NYC schools.

In summary, WMS has exceeded our expectations in every way. With dedicated staff, happy children, a strong parent community, and comprehensive exmissions support, it's the perfect choice for early childhood education and definitely the best 2s /3s program you can find in Tribeca. We are grateful for the enriching environment it has provided for our child's growth and development.

docs.text:
Google review of Vinegar Hill Veterinary Group- Dumbo (1 out of 5, by Be R, 3 months ago): Very unprofessional staff

If you want your exotic pet to recover, stay away from this place!

I spoke with them over the phone, and they told me they could see my pet as an emergency because they had no appointments available. They said the emergency exam would cost $275 and that the doctor would be able to see my pet.

When I arrived, the woman at the front desk was very cold. She handed me a form to fill out, and while I was doing that, she was busy talking to her coworker about another customer, an elderly woman who had "given her a hard time" because her cat was about to die. She clearly didn't seem to care whether that cat survived or not.

After I finished the paperwork, she quickly went into the back, came back about 10 seconds later, and told me the doctor couldn't see my pet after all. She said I would have to wait until the next day, when "another doctor" would be available, despite the fact that I had been told over the phone that my pet could be seen that day!!

I told her I wasn't sure my pet would survive until tomorrow, and all she said was, "There's nothing I can do."

This experience was completely unprofessional and showed a shocking lack of compassion for both pets and their owners.

docs.title: Review of Vinegar Hill Veterinary Group- Dumbo
docs.text:
Google review of Vinegar Hill Veterinary Group- Dumbo (2 out of 5, by Rob Curtis, 3 months ago): VHVG provides okay care, with frustrating billing practices - a pattern that's common in vet medicine, but pronounced here. Three months in, puppy vaccines for one dog and establishing care for the other. The care itself has been fine, enjoyed working with Dr. Pham. Otherwise its a pretty mid clinic, and I found their front desk staff to be quite cold and unfriendly.

The main issue I have with VHVG is their billing practices, which require constant vigilance to avoid being needlessly upsold or overcharged. Our puppy's vaccine series required several separate visits, and they [attempted] to route each one through a full doctor's exam fee - just to give a shot. Separately, I asked for a tech-only blood draw on our other dog for a routine annual blood test, despite the fact we brought her in for a wellness visit with the DVM [3] months prior, I was told a doctor exam was required. No explanation was given, just a pitch for a paid monthly membership.

I've had dogs all my life, and my partner and I own a [human] medical practice ourselves - we're no strangers to both veterinary norms and to the operational and financial demands of running a medical office. Even so, we found their insistence on billing an exam fee at nearly every turn to be either greedy or inefficient - neither of which reflects very well on how the practice is run. Their overall pricing also runs high, even by NYC standards. Add insult to injury, they charge a 3% credit card surcharge on every transaction, which for vet bills is expensive and also feels like an unnecessarily hostile business practice - this is a cost of doing business. As a business owner myself, I can tell you they are likely profiting on a fee, simply to pay them.

We've since decided to move our routine care elsewhere, and I recommend other potential customers/patients find veterinary care that separates routine services from full doctor exams, so you're not paying comprehensive exam fees just to get a shot or a blood draw.

From the front desk staff to the veterinary technicians and medical team, every single person I’ve encountered has been professional, attentive, and genuinely compassionate. It’s rare to find a practice where the entire office operates with such consistency and care, and it truly makes a difference.

During my most recent visit, my dog was very ill, which was understandably stressful. Dr. LoPresti conducted a thorough and thoughtful examination, and her bedside manner was exceptional. I had many questions, as my dog’s health is incredibly important to me, and she took the time to answer each one in detail. She explained even the smallest nuances with patience and clarity, ensuring I felt informed and reassured every step of the way.

Beyond the medical care, the facility itself is state-of-the-art, clean, and efficiently run. Scheduling, communication, and follow-up have always been seamless, which adds an extra level of trust and comfort.

I would highly recommend Battery Park Veterinary Hospital to anyone, whether for routine visits, dental care, or more serious medical concerns.
